product_name: 无人机远程识别信息监测设备
summary: 设备可独立监测识别无人机的远程识别广播信号(RemoteID,简称RID)，实时提取并显示无人机的序列号(SN)、型号、位置、速度、高度、起飞点以及飞手位置等多维信息。 可广泛应用于机场、高铁、电力园区、交通枢纽、重要活动安防、全域低空管控等场景下的目标无人机监管等重要场景，实现对无人机及飞手的探测识别监管。该设备可作为新型基础设施，满足城市空域管理建设需求，助力低空经济蓬勃发展。
summary_en: This equipment independently monitors and identifies drone Remote ID (RID) broadcast signals, extracting real-time multi-dimensional data such as serial number (SN), model, position, speed, altitude, takeoff point, and pilot location. It is widely applicable for airport security, high-speed rail, power industrial parks, transportation hubs, major event security, and regional low-altitude management. As a new type of infrastructure, it supports urban airspace management and contributes to the growth of the low-altitude economy.
key_application: 应用领域：可广泛应用于机场、高铁、电力园区、交通枢纽、重要活动安防、全域低空管控等场景下的目标无人机监管等重要场景，实现对无人机及飞手的探测识别监管。该设备可作为新型基础设施，满足城市空域管理建设需求，助力低空经济蓬勃发展。；目标解析定位；支持接收Remote ID报文，解析无人机ID、位置，飞手位置信息。
key_application_en: Real-time Remote ID (RID) monitoring for airports and industrial parks; extracts precise drone SN and pilot location; supports 4G/5G data transmission and multi-system networking; meets global safety standards (GB, ASTM, ASD-STAN).
key_parameter_2: 工作模式: Remote ID（标准）、ADS-B（拓展）

parameters.多目标监测: 无人机及飞手数量≥12架次(同时)

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 独立监测无线电广播RID信号，实时提取无人机序列号、型号、经纬度、起飞点及飞手位置信息。
  • 支持与频谱、雷达等设备深度组网，作为新型基础设施推动城市全域低空经济建设。
  • 超远距离ADS-B拓展：具备对民航及无人机ADS-B报文的解析库，提供空域冲突预警。
  • 多标准支持：符合中国GB42590-2023、美国ASTM及欧盟ASD-STAN安全标准。
  • 全天候设计：工业级密封结构，通过IP65防护测试，适应全地形严酷环境。
  • Figure 1 UAV Remote ID Monitoring System
detail_html_en:
Features

  • Independent RID monitoring: extracts serial numbers, locations, takeoff points, and pilot coordinates from Remote ID broadcasts.
  • Next-gen infrastructure: serves as a core node for urban airspace management and low-altitude economy growth.
  • ADS-B integration: expands situational awareness by decoding civil aviation and UAV ADS-B signals to prevent collisions.
  • Global compliance: meets mandatory safety requirements including GB42590-2023, ASTM F3411, and ASD-STAN.
  • Robust connectivity: supports wired network and 4G/5G data transmission for remote monitoring.
